identity.campaign_name: B.O.T.S. Linux v0.1 Phase 10 Campaign Desktop Integration
identity.purpose: Design, then after an exact Mick continuation implement and technically close the thin native desktop operational surface over the existing campaign engine.

objective.desired_outcome: Phase 10 operator-reachable campaign desktop integration preserving the headless engine and append-only filesystem evidence, with explicit spend authority, sibling regeneration, stale synthesis/rerun semantics, and truthful live/durable outcomes.
objective.technical_completion_definition: An exact sealed tracked candidate implements only the accepted Phase 10 design, focused validation passes, the final complete repository T4 passes on the exact final seal, fresh independent implementation review and final MiMo oracle are reconciled, filesystem evidence remains authoritative/backward-readable, and the campaign stops at the pre-commit boundary with nothing staged/committed/pushed unless later separately authorized.

provenance.meaning: Mick requested a Phase 10 Codex Campaign v0.3 pack using OrgMem design, thorough Git inspection, and model assignment based on observed campaign evidence plus creator claims/benchmarks.

Phase 10 is thin campaign desktop integration: load, zero-spend validate, preflight, explicit spend approval, live progress/cost, result inspection, sibling worker regeneration, stale synthesis and explicit rerun; do not replace campaign engine/evidence.
Product and architecture semantics for operational campaign UI, append-only regeneration, stale synthesis, durable filesystem evidence, and headless usability.
Phase 9 is closed and landed; Phase 10 is the next separate boundary.
